messages.author: 427356d65a15c6cc
messages.subject: Re: bezier curves
parts:
Hi Bogdan,

You could check out package Hmisc, there is a function called bezier to interpolate to bezier curve points, then you could specify two end point and one middle points, and  interpolated them to a set of points and create a bezier curve using simply geom line. 

HTH

Tengfei

messages.author: 2710b717e5dbb066
messages.subject: Re: bezier curves
parts:
R will do xsplines which given the correct arguments will give close
approximations to Bezier curves. There may be a way to use
grid.xspline to plot an xspline in a ggplot function, or you can use
the xspline function with draw=FALSE to get the xy points to
approximate the spline, then use ggplot functions to draw the path
through these points.
